verdict.rationale: smolagents is a Python library, not a hosted service, but it does expose a documented, code-level public API (Agent classes, Tool subclassing, push_to_hub/from_hub, reference docs) that AI-native users can drive programmatically. There's no evidence of a REST/HTTP API or OpenAPI spec specific to smolagents itself (the openapi.json probe is for huggingface.co generally, not smolagents), so 'documented public API' is satisfied only at the library/SDK level. missing for 10: a dedicated HTTP/REST API or OpenAPI spec for smolagents, independent third-party confirmation of API stability/completeness beyond HF docs.
